svg.title: Decoder animation
svg.text: A 20 ms window slides every 10 ms over the input. Real waveform of tap.orange, real thresholds. 32× slower.
Goertzel score of each symbol = the weaker of its two tones
A window names a symbol when
• both its tones are present, and
• it beats every other symbol by 2.5×.
Two windows in a row make a run;
three runs in the codebook make a message,
delivered as soon as the third run is stable.

g.text: delivered 110 ms after the code started
